grounded_answer_demonstrations.question: What is the maximum service credit for one incident?
grounded_answer_demonstrations.answer: An issued service credit expires after 30 calendar days, is non-transferable, and cannot be exchanged for cash. A service credit must not reimburse a charge already covered by a billing refund, and multiple reports about the same incident do not increase the INR 200 limit.

grounded_answer_demonstrations.question: How long are closed tickets and request logs retained?
grounded_answer_demonstrations.answer: Retain a ticket, its conversation, linked evidence, and feedback while it is active and for 90 calendar days after it enters Closed status; if it reopens, calculate the retention period from its next closure. Retain structured request logs for 30 calendar days from creation and mask phone numbers before request text enters a model or is written to a log.

grounded_answer_demonstrations.question: Is routine support available on Sunday?
grounded_answer_demonstrations.answer: Routine support operates Monday through Saturday from 09:00 to 18:00 Indian Standard Time, using the Asia/Kolkata time zone. Routine support is closed on Sundays and on the project holidays of 26 January, 15 August, and 2 October.

grounded_answer_demonstrations.question: What happens after a feedback rating of 1?
grounded_answer_demonstrations.answer: A rating of 1 or 2 requires Support Lead review within 1 business day, but does not automatically change the ticket severity or approve compensation. Invite feedback consistently from all eligible resolved cases and do not reward, suppress, or selectively request positive ratings.

grounded_answer_demonstrations.question: Can a verified VIP P3 ticket take priority over a P1 case?
grounded_answer_demonstrations.answer: All P1 cases take priority over P2 and P3 cases, so VIP status never moves a lower-severity case ahead of a more urgent one. The same SLA targets, refund-evidence requirements, and INR 200 service-credit limit apply to VIP and standard customers.

grounded_answer_demonstrations.question: What happens on the third report of the same unresolved complaint?
grounded_answer_demonstrations.answer: When new evidence shows that a Resolved or Closed issue remains unresolved, a human reopens the case as In Progress unless its severity requires immediate P1 handling. The third report of the same unresolved complaint within 30 calendar days requires Support Lead review, while an existing P1 case remains with its specialist lead.
